column1: # Expectation manifest for the src/*.rs:LINE cites in formal/tla/wal/.
# One row per DISTINCT ANCHOR, not per cite occurrence: ~193 occurrences across
# 17 files resolve to the 65 anchors below. Checked by
# formal/scripts/check-cites.py, which fails if a cite has no row here, if a row
# here is cited by nothing, or if a row's token is missing from / ambiguous in
#   range   a single line (1206) or an inclusive span (653-702)
#   rev     '-' for the working tree, or a git revision for a FROZEN cite that
#           deliberately names historical code (the '<sha>^' idiom). Frozen rows
#           are verified via `git show <rev>:<file>` -- never exempted. One of
#           them was wrong at creation precisely because nothing checked it.
#   token   plain substring (no regex). Must occur EXACTLY ONCE inside the
#           range. Pick something stable under reformatting but specific: a
#           signature, a distinctive expression, a struct field. Never a token
#           expectation proves nothing and the checker rejects it.
# Rows are sorted by file then first line. See formal/tla/wal/README.md,
# 'Source-line cites', for how to add a cite or record a frozen one.
